'''Aeona Cantor''' was a red-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the lover of [[Nick Rostu]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Aeona grew worried when her lover, Nick disappeared. She formed a group of resistance fighters to help in her search for Rostu. She eventually seized control of the famous [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in an attempt to rescue her lover. Rostu had become the servant of [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cronal|Blackhole]], prompting Aeona to form a rebellion against Blackhole. She was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the people on Mindor. She had a very hot temper when scouting near the smoking volcano on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].<ref name="LSSM" />

After [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] freed Rostu from Blackhole's control, she was reunited with her lover. When she next met with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Skywalker forced her to apologize and explain why she had needed and thus stolen the ''Falcon''. Cantor and Rostu later commandeered Cronal's personal modified [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]] shuttle to track down the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial's]] true body. After getting a message from [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] they rescued Luke and [[Kar Vastor]], another one of Blackhole's [[pawn]]s, from the drifting remains of Blackhole's [[Shadow Base]]. Together with Rostu and Vastor she went on to hunt down Cronal, who Rostu believed had survived.<ref name="LSSM" />
